intro.titlePart1: Classic Car Rent means much more than just
intro.p1: Classic Car Rent means much more than just renting sports cars: We rent pure emotions! We know that driving pleasure consists of much more than just a beautiful sports car. It doesn't matter whether you rent an Audi RS7 from us for a weekend for two or borrow a Lamborghini for a very special occasion. Treat yourself to a unique drive with a BMW M5 or explore the highway with an Audi RS6. Bring true motorsport feeling into your home with a Ferrari rental or enjoy true German sports car engineering on a drive in a Mercedes AMG. Anyone who wants to drive their dream car is in the best hands with Classic Car Rent - no matter which sports car brand your heart beats for.
intro.p2: On the other hand, if you don't want to rent a sports car or a luxury car yourself, but want to give others a real joy with a truly breathtaking gift idea, you are definitely well advised with our sports car vouchers!
